The story relies heavily on standard tropes and clichés often found in relationship dramas (e.g., meeting in a café after a breakup, ordering the wrong coffee to show a character has changed, cutting one's hair to symbolize a "fresh start," and sacrificing a relationship for a corporate promotion). Because the themes of ambition versus loyalty and post-breakup tension are explored in a very conventional and surface-level manner, the average reader will not gain any unique viewpoints, original ideas, or deeper understandings of human nature from reading it.
